_comment: Baselines are the numbers published in SKILL.md's 'What the tools were measured to do' table. Do not edit them to make a run pass -- see eval/README.md.

scenarios.note: A silhouette against itself. Establishes that the rasteriser and the aligner are self-consistent; every other IoU here is meaningless if this is not exactly 1.

REQUIRED NEAR-MISS. A part 2% too large must still clear the 95% IoU gate (measured 0.96124, closed form 1/1.02^2 = 0.96117). If IoU ever collapsed here, SKILL.md's 'read the ratio, not the IoU' rule would be wrong.

REQUIRED NEGATIVE. A sealed internal void removes 25% of the material and changes no silhouette at all. IoU must stay at 1.0 for SKILL.md's 'a silhouette gate is blind to internal geometry' warning to hold.
End-to-end homography check on a synthetic oblique shot: a known 40 mm segment must come back as 40 mm, and the rectified board must fill its frame.
